episodes.196244: One waterspout very briefly moved onshore in Ottawa county and tossed several beach chairs before quickly dissipating.
episodes.196918: Several waterspouts were reported over Lake Michigan on October 13th.
episodes.196921: Conditions were favorable for waterspout development over Lake Michigan with cooler air over the above normal water temps. Conditions lingered for a few days from 10/12 thru 10/15. In all, 10 Special marine warnings were issued at various times during this period.
episodes.202209: During the morning of October 13th, a warm front drifted northward across much of NE OH and toward the Lake Erie shore as a surface low moved east-northeastward from central IL to NW OH. Along and near the surface warm front, scattered multicell thunderstorms persisted eastward across NE OH. One of these storms produced hail up to penny-size in Campbell, near Youngstown, amidst weak MUCAPE and moderate effective bulk shear.

events.narrative: Hail up to penny-size in Campbell.
